cards.canonicalName: Costco Anywhere Visa Card by Citi

benefits.name: 5% cash back on Costco gas; 4% cash back on other eligible gas & EV charging
benefits.amountDisplay: 5% at Costco gas / 4% other gas & EV charging, on first $7,000 combined per year, then 1%
benefits.howToUse: Automatic, no enrollment. Earns at Costco stations worldwide and anywhere gas/EV-charging merchants code correctly. 2025 change: Costco gas rose from 4% to 5% (effective Jan 19, 2025), raising max gas earnings from $280 to $350/yr. Reddit/EV-community trick: Tesla Superchargers often code as 'Tesla' (not gas) and may earn only 1% — pay through the ChargePoint or Electrify America apps to get the 4% coding; Ford Blue Oval plug-and-charge bills through Ford and codes at 1%. Note: gas at supermarket- or warehouse-branded stations other than Costco does not earn 4%.

benefits.name: 3% cash back on restaurants & eligible travel worldwide
benefits.howToUse: Automatic, no enrollment. Covers restaurants (incl. cafes, bars, fast food) and eligible travel: airfare, hotels, car rentals, travel agencies, cruise lines, and Costco Travel bookings. Costco Travel edge case: bookings made directly through Costco Travel can stack the card's 3% with the Executive membership 2% reward for ~5% total (exclusions and travel-completion rules apply); merchant category codes determine eligibility, so large trip purchases should go to a qualifying travel merchant.

benefits.name: 2% cash back on Costco & Costco.com purchases
benefits.amountDisplay: 2% (unlimited)
benefits.howToUse: Automatic, no enrollment. Applies to all in-warehouse and Costco.com purchases (gas at Costco earns the higher 5% rate instead). Stacks with the separate Executive membership 2% annual reward for a combined ~4% on eligible Costco merchandise purchases.

benefits.name: 1% cash back on all other purchases
benefits.amountDisplay: 1% (unlimited)
benefits.howToUse: Automatic, no enrollment. Base rate on everything outside the bonus categories, and on gas/EV charging beyond the $7,000 annual cap.

benefits.name: Annual reward certificate (rewards payout)
benefits.amountDisplay: 100% of cash back earned Jan–Dec, paid once per year
benefits.howToUse: No enrollment. Citi tallies all rewards earned during the calendar year and issues a single reward certificate shortly after your February billing statement closes; redeem it in person at any U.S. Costco warehouse (including Puerto Rico) for merchandise or cash before December 31 of the issue year. Trick: use the certificate on one small purchase and the register gives you the remaining balance in cash. Lesser-known: if your certificate totals $300+, Citi offers direct deposit to your bank account via the Citi Mobile app or citi.com, skipping the warehouse trip. Critical caveats: close the account before the February certificate is issued and you forfeit the year's rewards entirely; cancelling Costco membership closes the card.

benefits.name: Executive membership reward stacking
benefits.amountDisplay: Extra 2% annual reward (up to $1,250/yr) on qualifying Costco purchases
benefits.howToUse: Requires upgrading to the $130/yr Executive membership (vs $65 Gold Star). The Executive 2% reward is a separate certificate issued ~2 months before renewal and stacks with the card's own 2% on Costco purchases (~4% total) and ~5% on qualifying Costco Travel bookings (3% card + 2% Executive). Quirk: gasoline is explicitly excluded from the Executive 2%, so Costco gas stays at the card's 5% only — no 7%. Costco guarantees the upgrade: if your 2% reward doesn't cover the $65 upgrade premium, Costco refunds the shortfall, so trying Executive is risk-free.

benefits.name: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.amountDisplay: 0% on all purchases in non-USD currency
benefits.howToUse: Automatic, no enrollment — use the card anywhere Visa is accepted abroad with no FX surcharge. Costco warehouses exist in 14+ countries; note some international Costco locations don't accept Visa, so check before traveling.

benefits.name: Auto rental collision damage waiver
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $50,000 per rental; rentals up to 31 days
benefits.howToUse: Automatic when you charge the full rental to the card and decline the rental agency's collision coverage. Coverage is PRIMARY when renting outside the U.S. and SECONDARY to your personal insurance inside the U.S. FinanceBuzz notes it applies worldwide, unlike many U.S.-only rental benefits.

benefits.name: Travel accident insurance
benefits.howToUse: Automatic when you pay for the trip with the card. Pays up to $250,000 for accidental death or dismemberment (loss of limb, sight, speech, or hearing) while traveling on a common carrier.

benefits.name: Travel & emergency assistance
benefits.amountDisplay: 24/7 assistance hotline (varies)
benefits.howToUse: Call Citi's travel and emergency assistance service when traveling for help with emergency travel arrangements, medical/legal referrals, and travel information; charges for any services arranged are billed to the card.

benefits.name: Damage & theft purchase protection
benefits.amountDisplay: $1,000 per claim; $50,000 per cardmember per year; 120 days from purchase (90 days for NY residents)
benefits.howToUse: Automatic on eligible items bought with the card. File a claim with Citi's benefits administrator within the coverage window for repair or refund if the item is damaged or stolen. Note: the card's separate extended warranty (2 extra years) was DISCONTINUED for purchases after January 21, 2023 — items bought before that date keep their coverage; purchase protection is the warranty-adjacent benefit that remains.

benefits.name: Citi Entertainment presale access
benefits.amountDisplay: Presale & exclusive event access (no fixed $ value)
benefits.howToUse: Log in with your card at citientertainment.com to buy presale tickets and exclusive packages for concerts, sporting events, dining experiences, and more. No enrollment fee; card use required for purchase.

benefits.name: Free FICO credit score access
benefits.amountDisplay: FICO score dashboard
benefits.howToUse: Automatic for Citi cardholders — view your FICO score and credit-report summary in the Citi Mobile app or at citi.com at no charge.

benefits.name: Card doubles as Costco membership ID
benefits.amountDisplay: Membership verification built in
benefits.howToUse: While both accounts stay active, the credit card scans as your Costco membership card at warehouse entrances and registers — one card to carry.

benefits.name: No fee for authorized users + $0 liability
benefits.amountDisplay: $0 AU fee; $0 liability for unauthorized charges
benefits.howToUse: Add authorized users at no charge through your Citi account; they're Citi-managed. Zero-liability protection applies automatically — you don't pay for unauthorized transactions reported to Citi.

cards.canonicalName: Chase Amazon Prime Rewards Visa Signature
cards.annualFeeDisplay: $0 (requires Amazon Prime membership, $139/yr, billed separately by Amazon)

benefits.name: 5% back at Amazon and Whole Foods Market
benefits.amountDisplay: 5% (uncapped; Prime members only — 3% for non-Prime cardholders on the sibling Amazon Visa)
benefits.howToUse: No enrollment. Requires an eligible Prime membership linked to the same Amazon account the card is tied to (student/trial Prime count). Covers Amazon.com, Amazon Fresh, participating Amazon sites/stores, and Amazon gift cards. Rewards tracked as points (100 pts = $1), unlimited, never expire while the account is in good standing.

benefits.name: 5% back on Chase Travel purchases
benefits.amountDisplay: 5% (Prime members)
benefits.howToUse: Book travel through chasetravel.com or the number on the back of the card to earn 5% — but compare prices with other booking sites first, since Chase Travel prices can run higher. Added in the May 2023 relaunch.

benefits.name: 2% back at restaurants, gas stations, and local transit/commuting
benefits.amountDisplay: 2% (uncapped)
benefits.howToUse: No enrollment. Transit/commuting covers trains, buses, rideshare (Uber/Lyft), tolls and parking garages. Watch merchant coding: gas must code as a gas station, dining as a restaurant — marketplace food-delivery apps often don't count. Note: drugstores were 2% before 2023 and are now 1%.

benefits.name: 1% back on all other purchases
benefits.amountDisplay: 1% (uncapped)
benefits.howToUse: Automatic on everything outside the bonus categories. Below-market as a general-spend rate (average rewards card pays ~1.18%), so most holders keep this card in a drawer except at Amazon/Whole Foods/travel/dining.

benefits.name: Signup bonus: $150 Amazon gift card upon approval
benefits.amountDisplay: $150 Amazon gift card (Prime members; no spending requirement)
benefits.howToUse: Apply through Amazon/Chase while a Prime member; the gift card loads to the Amazon account's Gift Card Balance instantly upon approval. Bonus amount rotates: $250 Nov 2025–Jan 2026 (all-time best), $150 since Jan 2026, $200 seen mid-2026 — consider waiting for a higher window. Because there's no spend requirement, the IRS treats it as taxable income.

benefits.name: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.amountDisplay: $0 foreign transaction fee (saves ~3% vs typical cards)
benefits.howToUse: Automatic — use the card anywhere Visa is accepted abroad; no enrollment or activation needed.

benefits.name: Purchase protection
benefits.amountDisplay: $500 per claim, $50,000 per account; covers new purchases 120 days from purchase against damage or theft
benefits.howToUse: Automatic on eligible purchases — file a claim with the Benefit Administrator (1-800-847-2911) within 60 days of the incident. A quietly valuable perk since many cash-back cards have dropped it.

benefits.name: Extended warranty protection
benefits.amountDisplay: Adds 1 year to eligible U.S. manufacturers' warranties of 3 years or less (coverage up to 4 years from purchase date)
benefits.howToUse: Automatic on eligible items bought with the card. Particularly useful for electronics and appliances bought on Amazon — register nothing; file a claim if the item fails after the manufacturer's warranty expires.

benefits.name: Baggage delay insurance
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $100/day for up to 3 days
benefits.howToUse: Automatic when you charge the trip to the card. Reimburses essential purchases (toiletries, clothing) when checked baggage is delayed 6+ hours by a passenger carrier — file a claim, keep receipts.

benefits.name: Lost luggage reimbursement
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $3,000 per passenger
benefits.howToUse: Automatic on trips paid with the card. Covers repair or replacement of checked or carry-on baggage that is lost, damaged, or stolen by the carrier — applies to you and immediate family members.

benefits.name: Travel accident insurance
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $500,000 accidental death & dismemberment coverage
benefits.howToUse: Automatic when you pay for air, bus, train, or cruise fares with the card. No enrollment — coverage applies to the cardholder traveling on a common carrier.

benefits.name: Auto rental collision damage waiver
benefits.amountDisplay: Covers theft and collision damage to most rental cars
benefits.howToUse: Charge the entire rental to the card and decline the rental company's collision coverage. Coverage is secondary to your personal auto insurance in the U.S.; international terms per the Guide to Benefits.

benefits.name: Roadside dispatch
benefits.amountDisplay: 24/7 roadside dispatch service (service fees apply; dispatch itself is the benefit)
benefits.howToUse: Call the number on the back of the card for towing, tire changes, lockout service, or fuel delivery anywhere in the U.S. — you pay the service provider's fee, Chase handles the dispatch.

benefits.name: Travel & emergency assistance
benefits.amountDisplay: 24/7 assistance hotline (no dollar amount)
benefits.howToUse: Call for emergency travel help — medical/legal referrals, lost luggage or passport assistance, emergency cash — coordination is covered, the actual services are at your cost.

benefits.name: Visa Signature concierge
benefits.amountDisplay: 24/7 complimentary concierge
benefits.howToUse: Call Visa Signature Concierge (number on the back of the card) for dinner reservations, event tickets, travel planning, or gift sourcing — free service, you pay for whatever is booked.

benefits.name: Visa Signature Luxury Hotel Collection
benefits.amountDisplay: 900+ luxury hotels; best-available-rate guarantee, automatic room upgrades, complimentary in-room Wi-Fi
benefits.howToUse: Book through the Visa Signature Luxury Hotel Collection portal with the card. Upgrade and Wi-Fi are automatic when you book a qualifying stay — no status or enrollment required.

benefits.name: Flexible redemption: Shop with Points, statement credit, or cash (all 1 cent/point)
benefits.amountDisplay: 100 points = $1.00 across all redemption options; no minimum to redeem at Amazon checkout
benefits.howToUse: Since the 2023 relaunch you earn, view, and redeem rewards daily (as soon as the next day), not monthly. COMMUNITY TRICK #1 (Shop-with-Points trap): Amazon checkout prompts you to 'pay with points,' but points spent that way earn NO new rewards on the purchase — and the value is the same 1¢/pt as redeeming via Chase. Better move: pay with the card at 5% and redeem points through Chase as a statement credit (or cash deposit to a Chase checking account) at the same 1¢/pt, so the purchase still earns 5% back. Turn OFF 'use points automatically' in Amazon payment settings so checkout doesn't silently eat them.

benefits.name: Prime Card Bonus: rotating 10%+ back offers (incl. 6% with Amazon Day Delivery)
benefits.amountDisplay: 10% back or more on select items/categories; 6% back on Amazon Day Delivery orders
benefits.howToUse: COMMUNITY TRICK #2: Before any big Amazon order, check the 'Prime Card Bonus' page on Amazon for rotating boosted-reward offers (electronics, seasonal categories) — these stack on top of the base 5% and rotate constantly, so timing a purchase can double your earn. Also choose Amazon Day Delivery at checkout when available for 6% instead of 5%.

benefits.name: Equal Monthly Payments: 0% promo APR on qualifying Amazon purchases
benefits.amountDisplay: 0% promo APR for 6–12 months on qualifying Amazon or Amazon Pay purchases (offers vary)
benefits.howToUse: COMMUNITY TRICK #3 (warning): Equal Pay buys earn NO rewards — if you can pay in full, skip it and take the 5% back instead; financing a purchase at 0% while giving up 5% is a worse deal than it looks. Only use when cash flow genuinely requires it.

benefits.name: Refer-a-friend bonus
benefits.amountDisplay: $50 per approved referral, up to $500 per calendar year (10 referrals)
benefits.howToUse: Generate your referral link from the dedicated Amazon Visa refer-a-friend page (not the usual Chase refer-a-friend hub). You get $50 per approved account, capped at $500/year.

benefits.name: 5% Sam's Cash on gas and EV charging
benefits.amountDisplay: 5% on first $6,000/yr, then 1%
benefits.howToUse: Automatic on eligible gas-station and EV-charging purchases anywhere Mastercard is accepted; no enrollment. Quirk per TPG: the 5% rate EXCLUDES gas at warehouse clubs other than Sam's Club (Costco gas earns 1%) and gas stations at grocery stores, unlike some rival cards. Merchant category codes control classification, so a fuel purchase through a non-gas-coded merchant may earn a different rate.

benefits.name: 3% Sam's Cash on dining and takeout
benefits.howToUse: Automatic on eligible restaurant and takeout purchases anywhere (not just Sam's); no enrollment. Per Bankrate, the dining category specifically includes caterers, unlike many restaurant bonus categories — useful for event-prep spending.

benefits.name: 3% Sam's Cash on Sam's Club purchases for Plus members (1% for Club members)
benefits.amountDisplay: 3% Plus / 1% Club
benefits.howToUse: Automatic based on membership tier; no card enrollment. A Plus member's 2% membership Sam's Cash stacks with the card's 3%, so in-club purchases earn 5% total, calculated independently on the same receipt (card rewards do not count against the Plus program's $750/yr cap). Note: Plus is now $120/yr (up from $110 on May 1, 2026).

benefits.name: 1% Sam's Cash on all other purchases
benefits.howToUse: Automatic on all other eligible purchases. Total card-earned Sam's Cash is capped at $5,000 per calendar year across all categories. No cash back on tobacco, e-cigarettes, prescription drugs, gift cards, or other cash equivalents.

benefits.name: Sam's Cash payout and redemption
benefits.amountDisplay: 100% of earned rewards
benefits.howToUse: Earned Sam's Cash is calculated and loaded automatically to the membership account monthly (within 1–2 billing cycles), not annually — no action needed; visible in the Sam's Club app. Redeem in-club, online, in-app, via Scan & Go, or curbside; you can apply a partial amount as a discount at checkout. Redeeming as a discount slightly devalues rewards vs cash since the discounted purchase earns less back — per Reddit cardholders, the better move is cashing out at the Member Services desk, which pays real cash (minimum $25 balance to cash out; takes ~5 minutes). Also usable to pay membership renewal fees. It is NOT a statement credit and cannot reduce the card balance. Sam's Cash never expires while membership is active and the account is in good standing, but it is forfeited if the membership lapses (available rewards may expire 6 months after non-renewal) or the account goes delinquent/closed.

benefits.name: $30 welcome statement credit
benefits.amountDisplay: $30 statement credit
benefits.howToUse: Spend $30+ on Sam's Club purchases within the first 30 days of account opening; the credit posts automatically. Confirm the current offer at application — promo amounts have varied (a $50 offer ran Feb 5–25, 2026).

benefits.name: Sam's Cash Bonus Offers (card-linked offers)
benefits.amountDisplay: Varies by offer, typically 1–30%
benefits.howToUse: Free card-linked program separate from the card's earn rates. Link an eligible card (Mastercard, Visa, or Amex) in the Sam's Club app under Sam's Cash → 'Earn with Bonus Offers', then ACTIVATE each offer before purchase — some offers require activation per transaction and the offer must be active at the time of purchase. Merchants include restaurants, streaming services, and retailers. Bonus Offers Sam's Cash has no annual maximum and stacks on top of normal card rewards.

benefits.name: No foreign transaction fee
benefits.howToUse: Automatic on all international purchases, since the card is accepted anywhere Mastercard is accepted worldwide.

benefits.name: Doubles as Sam's Club membership card
benefits.amountDisplay: Free (embedded barcode)
benefits.howToUse: The physical card carries the membership barcode, so no separate membership card is needed — use it to enter the club, at registers, and with Scan & Go in the app (including Scan & Go Fuel: scan the pump QR code and pay without a separate membership card).

benefits.name: Zero fraud liability (Mastercard)
benefits.amountDisplay: $0 liability
benefits.howToUse: Automatic Mastercard network protection against unauthorized use; no enrollment.

benefits.name: Plus membership 2% Sam's Cash (stacks with card)
benefits.amountDisplay: 2% (up to $750/membership year as of May 2026)
benefits.howToUse: Membership benefit, not a card benefit, but it's the stacking mechanism the card is designed around: Plus members earn 2% Sam's Cash on qualifying in-club purchases (Scan & Go and curbside included; online excluded) plus the card's 3% = 5% total. The 2% membership cap was raised from $500 to $750 per membership year when Plus pricing went to $120/yr on May 1, 2026.

cards.canonicalName: Southwest Rapid Rewards Premier Credit Card

benefits.name: Welcome bonus
benefits.amountDisplay: 55,000 bonus points after $1,500 spend in first 3 months from account opening
benefits.howToUse: Automatic once the spend threshold is met; current public offer as of late Sept/Oct 2026. Offers rotate (85k, 100k, and Companion-Pass-plus-30k-after-$4k offers have appeared historically). Not eligible if you currently hold any personal Southwest card or earned a bonus on one in the past 24 months; you may hold only one personal Southwest card at a time (business cards don't count against this), and Chase 5/24 applies.

benefits.name: Anniversary points
benefits.amountDisplay: 6,000 points each cardmember anniversary
benefits.howToUse: Posts automatically after your account anniversary (no action needed); redeemable like any Rapid Rewards points and counts toward the Companion Pass 135,000-point threshold. The annual fee posting and the points post around the same anniversary cycle each year.

benefits.name: Earn rates
benefits.amountDisplay: 3x on Southwest purchases; 2x at grocery stores and restaurants on first $8,000 combined per anniversary year; 1x on everything else
benefits.howToUse: Automatic on all eligible spend. 3x covers flights, inflight, and Southwest gift cards purchased directly; Lyft rides earn 3x total through 12/31/2027 (set this card as the default in the Lyft app). Note the 2x cap: after $8,000 in combined grocery/restaurant spend per anniversary year, those categories drop to 1x.

benefits.name: No foreign transaction fees
benefits.amountDisplay: 0% foreign transaction fee
benefits.howToUse: Automatic on purchases made outside the U.S.; no enrollment needed. Chase notes $5,000 in international spend avoids ~$150 in typical 3% foreign fees.

benefits.name: Free first checked bag
benefits.amountDisplay: First checked bag free for cardmember + up to 8 companions on the same reservation
benefits.howToUse: Automatic when you fly Southwest with the card account open — the card replaces Southwest's standard $45-per-bag-per-leg fee (up to ~$90 round trip per person). Requirement: all travelers must be booked in the same reservation; Basic-fare tickets are included.

benefits.name: Group 5 boarding
benefits.amountDisplay: Board no later than Group 5 for cardmember + up to 8 companions on the same reservation
benefits.howToUse: Automatic on every Southwest flight; no enrollment needed. With assigned seating (since Jan 2026) this mainly gets you earlier overhead-bin access rather than better seats — it stacks on top of your assigned seat, and companions must be on the same reservation to get the group.

benefits.name: Preferred seat selection 48 hours before departure
benefits.amountDisplay: Complimentary Standard or Preferred seat selection within 48 hours prior to departure, when available
benefits.howToUse: Log into your Southwest account within 48 hours of departure and re-select a Preferred seat (front-of-plane, free of charge). The practical trick: check exactly at the 48-hour mark — the best free Preferred seats go within minutes as cardholders and A-List members grab them. Basic-fare flyers without a card can only pick seats at check-in, so this is the card's workaround.

benefits.name: 15% flight discount promo code
benefits.amountDisplay: One 15% promo code per cardmember anniversary year
benefits.howToUse: Issued each anniversary year; apply the code at booking on Southwest. Does NOT work on Basic fares — use it on a Choice or higher fare. Best saved for a big-ticket round trip where 15% beats the value of paying with points.

benefits.name: Tier Qualifying Points (TQPs) toward A-List
benefits.amountDisplay: 1,500 TQPs for every $5,000 spent on the card, unlimited
benefits.howToUse: Posts per billing cycle; A-List status requires 35,000 TQPs in a calendar year (so $117,000 in spend would get there alone — most use it to top up flight-earned TQPs). Important: TQPs earned this way do NOT count toward the Companion Pass — that is a separate 135,000-qualifying-points threshold fed by redeemable points. Don't confuse the two currencies; they're parallel tracks.

benefits.name: Companion Pass qualifying-points boost
benefits.amountDisplay: 10,000 Companion Pass qualifying points each calendar year
benefits.howToUse: Posted automatically around January 1 each year just for holding the card. These points count ONLY toward the Companion Pass (not redeemable for flights) — a free ~7.4% head start on the 135,000-point threshold. Stack it with the fact that every point earned on this card (welcome bonus, anniversary points, all card spending) also counts toward Companion Pass.

benefits.name: Companion Pass mechanics (how card points count)
benefits.amountDisplay: 135,000 qualifying points per calendar year unlocks Companion Pass (valid remainder of year + all of next year)
benefits.howToUse: All points earned on the card — welcome bonus, 6,000 anniversary points, and everyday spend — count toward the 135,000/year threshold (flights booked on points don't; flights booked with flight credits do). Timing trick from frequent-flyer circles: complete the welcome-bonus spend so points post after Jan 1 (points post at statement close) and/or apply early in the year, so the pass stretches nearly 24 months instead of ~12. A second, separate trick: pair one personal + one Southwest business card — their bonuses don't block each other, so peak combined bonuses can exceed the 135k threshold in one shot. You may hold only one personal Southwest card, but personal + business is allowed.

benefits.name: 25% back on inflight purchases
benefits.amountDisplay: 25% back on inflight purchases charged to the card
benefits.howToUse: Automatic as a statement credit when you buy drinks, snacks, or Wi-Fi onboard with the card. Wi-Fi gets no separate free-inflight-WiFi perk on this card — the 25% discount is the Wi-Fi perk.

benefits.name: Travel and purchase protections
benefits.amountDisplay: Lost luggage up to $3,000/covered traveler; baggage delay $100/day up to 3 days (delays over 6 hours); extended warranty +1 year on warranties of 3 years or less; purchase protection $500/item for 120 days (90 in NY)
benefits.howToUse: All automatic when you pay with the card — no enrollment. File claims through the Visa benefit administrator; keep receipts and documentation, as time limits apply. Note this card has no trip cancellation/interruption insurance (that's a Reserve/Sapphire-level perk, not on the Southwest line).

benefits.name: DoorDash DashPass membership
benefits.amountDisplay: One-year complimentary DashPass; must activate by Dec 31, 2027
benefits.howToUse: Activate DashPass by Dec 31, 2027 via the Chase offer page. After the free year it auto-enrolls at the paid monthly rate — set a reminder to cancel.

benefits.name: DoorDash $10 quarterly credit (non-restaurant orders)
benefits.amountDisplay: $10 off per quarter; through Dec 31, 2027
benefits.howToUse: Applies to grocery, convenience, and retail orders (not restaurants) while DashPass is active; discount applies automatically at checkout on eligible orders.

benefits.name: Instacart credits
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $120/year: 3 months complimentary Instacart+ + $10 monthly Instacart credit; through Dec 31, 2027
benefits.howToUse: Enroll via Chase's Instacart portal and activate by Dec 31, 2027. Catch: you need an active Instacart+ membership for the $10 monthly statement credit to post — the free 3 months covers that window, then credits stop unless you keep paying for Instacart+. Use-it-or-lose-it each month.

benefits.name: Refer-a-friend bonus
benefits.amountDisplay: 20,000 bonus points per approved referral, up to 100,000 points per year
benefits.howToUse: Share your unique referral link (Chase app/website) — you get 20,000 points for each friend approved for any Southwest Rapid Rewards credit card. Referral-earned points also count toward Companion Pass qualifying points.

benefits.name: 5% cash back on travel booked through Chase Travel
benefits.howToUse: Automatic, no enrollment or activation needed — just book flights, hotels, and car rentals via the Chase Travel portal. Tip: portal bookings also let you pay with points combined from other Chase cards for boosted value (Points Boost); direct airline/hotel bookings earn only the 1.5% base rate.

benefits.name: 3% cash back on dining (restaurants, takeout, eligible delivery)
benefits.howToUse: Automatic, no activation. Reddit trick: buy restaurant gift cards through the United MileagePlus X app with this card — the purchase still codes as dining (3x) and you stack airline miles on top.

benefits.name: 3% cash back at drugstores
benefits.howToUse: Automatic, no activation, no cap — one of the few uncapped 3% drugstore categories on any no-fee card. Reddit staples: CVS/Walgreens sell gift cards to hundreds of other retailers, so you can effectively earn 3x on non-drugstore spending by buying gift cards there; some holders pay pharmacy bills on this card and reimburse themselves from an HSA for 3x plus tax-free dollars.

benefits.name: 1.5% cash back on all other purchases
benefits.howToUse: Automatic flat rate with no cap — no activation and no category management needed. The card's value jumps when you combine these points with a Sapphire or Ink Preferred card (see combining entry).

benefits.name: Welcome bonus: $200 after spending $500 in the first 3 months
benefits.howToUse: Apply and meet the $500 spend within 3 months of account opening; bonus posts automatically. Conventions: $200 is the long-standing standard offer (a $250 limited-time bonus was the highest fixed offer TPG has seen on this card). Doctor of Credit notes an in-branch-only variant: $200 plus 5% on gas and grocery for the first year. Note Chase's unpublished 5/24 rule can deny you if you've opened 5+ cards in 24 months.

benefits.name: Combine/move Ultimate Rewards points with a premium Chase card
benefits.amountDisplay: points become transferable (TPG values Chase points at 2.05¢ each as of Sept 2026)
benefits.howToUse: Alone, this card's rewards are cash back worth 1¢ each. Pair it with a Sapphire Preferred/Reserve or Ink Business Preferred and you can move Freedom points to that card via Chase's 'Combine Points' (Ultimate Rewards > Rewards Details > Combine Points — transfers are instant), unlocking 1:1 transfers to airline/hotel partners (Hyatt, United, Southwest, etc.) and Points Boost portal bookings at 1.25–1.5¢ per point. Reddit/churning habit: sweep your points to the premium card every statement cycle so a policy change can't strand them, and you can combine points with a household member's Chase card by calling Chase to link the accounts.

benefits.name: 0% intro APR on purchases and balance transfers for 15 months
benefits.amountDisplay: 0% for 15 months, then 18.24%–27.74% variable
benefits.howToUse: Automatic for new accounts — no enrollment. Useful for financing a large purchase or consolidating debt, but pay it off before month 15 or the high variable rate kicks in. Balance transfer fee: $5 or 3% per transfer (whichever is greater) within the first 60 days, rising to 5% (min $5) after.

benefits.name: Foreign transaction fee (not waived)
benefits.amountDisplay: 3% of each transaction in USD
benefits.howToUse: This card charges a 3% foreign transaction fee — confirmed across all sources. Do not use it for purchases outside the US or in foreign currency; use a no-foreign-transaction-fee card instead.

benefits.name: Purchase protection
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $500 per item (max $50,000 per account)
benefits.howToUse: Automatic — covers eligible new purchases against damage or theft for 120 days from the purchase date (90 days for New York residents). File claims through the benefit administrator listed in your Guide to Benefits.

benefits.name: Extended warranty protection
benefits.amountDisplay: +1 year beyond manufacturer warranty (max 4 years from purchase)
benefits.howToUse: Automatic when you pay with the card: adds one year to eligible US manufacturer's warranties of 3 years or less. Most people forget this on a no-fee card — use the Freedom Unlimited for electronics and appliances instead of paying with debit.

benefits.name: Trip cancellation/interruption insurance
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $1,500 per covered traveler, $6,000 per trip
benefits.howToUse: Automatic — charge prepaid, non-refundable travel to the card to be covered if the trip is canceled or cut short by sickness, severe weather, or other covered situations. Note this is NOT trip-delay insurance; there is no delay coverage on this card.

benefits.name: Auto rental collision coverage
benefits.amountDisplay: Reimbursement for theft/collision damage on most rentals
benefits.howToUse: Decline the rental company's collision insurance and charge the entire rental to the card. Coverage is secondary to your personal auto insurance for US rentals. Lesser-known: outside the US, the card's coverage becomes primary, which can make it a decent pick for international rentals despite the foreign transaction fee.

benefits.name: Complimentary DashPass membership (6 months)
benefits.amountDisplay: 6 months ($0 delivery fees + lower service fees)
benefits.howToUse: Activate through the Chase benefits link by December 31, 2027 (deadline re-extended). Warning: after the 6 months you are automatically enrolled at the current monthly rate unless you cancel — set a reminder.

benefits.name: $10 quarterly DoorDash credit (non-restaurant orders)
benefits.amountDisplay: $10/quarter
benefits.howToUse: DashPass members get up to $10 off per quarter on non-restaurant DoorDash orders (grocery, convenience, etc.) through December 31, 2027 — separate from the restaurant benefit, so it stacks. This silent quarterly credit is the piece most cardholders never notice; use it on a grocery run each quarter.

benefits.name: 2% cash back on Lyft
benefits.amountDisplay: 2% total through 09/30/2027
benefits.howToUse: Automatic — pay for qualifying Lyft products/services through the Lyft mobile app with this card; you earn the base 1.5% plus an extra 0.5%. No enrollment. This is separate from (and stacks with, for non-credit-covered rides) a Sapphire Reserve cardholder's $10/month Lyft in-app credit, which runs through the same Sept 30, 2027 end date.

benefits.name: Chase Offers (targeted cash-back offers)
benefits.amountDisplay: varies by offer
benefits.howToUse: Activate targeted offers in the Chase mobile app or on chase.com, then pay with this card — the statement credit posts within 30 days. Offers are targeted per cardholder, so check the app regularly; missed/off-cycle offers are the usual reason people get nothing from this.

benefits.name: Redeem points for cash back / Amazon / gift cards / travel
benefits.amountDisplay: 1¢ per point for cash
benefits.howToUse: No minimum to redeem: statement credit or direct deposit to an eligible Chase account, gift cards, Amazon checkout (link the card), or Chase Travel. Amazon pay-with-points redeems at a poor value — the classic trap is burning points there instead of combining them with a Sapphire card for transfer partners or Points Boost.

benefits.name: Chase Credit Journey (free credit score + identity monitoring)
benefits.amountDisplay: free
benefits.howToUse: Enroll free via the Chase app or chase.com to get your Experian-based score, score-improvement plans, and identity monitoring with alerts — no enrollment fee and no card use required.

benefits.name: Zero liability + 24/7 fraud monitoring
benefits.amountDisplay: $0 liability for unauthorized charges
benefits.howToUse: Automatic: you are not held responsible for unauthorized charges, and Chase monitors for fraud around the clock, alerting you by text, email, or call on suspicious activity.

benefits.name: Unlimited 1.5% cash back on all purchases
benefits.amountDisplay: 1.5% (earned as Ultimate Rewards points, 1¢ each for cash back)
benefits.howToUse: No categories, no caps, no activation — every business purchase earns 1.5% and points don't expire while the account is open. Earnings post as Ultimate Rewards points (worth 1¢ each as cash back, statement credit, gift cards, or travel). Stack extra rewards by clicking through the Shop through Chase section of your Chase online account before an online purchase.

benefits.name: New cardmember welcome bonus
benefits.amountDisplay: $750 bonus cash back (posts as 75,000 UR points) after $6,000 spend in first 3 months
benefits.howToUse: Bonus arrives as 75,000 Ultimate Rewards points, not literal cash — much more valuable when combined with a premium Chase card. Chase now enforces a once-per-lifetime Ink family rule: the bonus may be denied if you've ever had this card or any other no-annual-fee Chase business card (also consider Chase's ~1 business card per 30 days velocity norm). Elevated offers come and go: a 100,000-point / $1,000 offer ($8,000 in 4 months) ran June 14 – Sept 17, 2026.

benefits.name: Combine and transfer Ultimate Rewards points
benefits.amountDisplay: Points pool with other Chase cards; partner transfers require a premium Chase card
benefits.howToUse: Use Chase's 'Combine points' tool to move Unlimited points to a Sapphire Preferred/Reserve or Ink Business Preferred, which unlocks transfers to United, Southwest, Hyatt, etc. and portal boosts. Since the Oct 1, 2026 change, Sapphire Preferred and Ink Business Preferred transfer to Hyatt at 4:3 instead of 1:1 — but the Sapphire Reserve still transfers 1:1, so routing points through a Reserve preserves full Hyatt value.

benefits.name: 5% cash back on Lyft
benefits.amountDisplay: 5% cash back on Lyft rides through September 30, 2027
benefits.howToUse: Automatic when you pay with the card — no enrollment. Shared benefit across Chase Ink cards.

benefits.name: Complimentary Instacart+ trial plus monthly Instacart credit
benefits.amountDisplay: 3 free months of Instacart+ (then $99/year) + $20/month Instacart credit; benefits end 12/31/27
benefits.howToUse: Enrollment required on the Chase/Instacart offer page; the $20 monthly credit loads automatically into your Instacart Business account once activated. Don't forget to cancel or accept the $99/year auto-renewal after the trial.

benefits.name: 0% intro APR on purchases (12 months)
benefits.amountDisplay: 0% for 12 months from account opening, then 16.99%–24.99% variable APR
benefits.howToUse: Covers new purchases only (no balance-transfer offer) — useful for financing large equipment buys interest-free in year one. Pay down before month 12 or the standard rate kicks in on the remainder.

benefits.name: Free employee cards with spending limits
benefits.amountDisplay: $0 per employee card; rewards pool into the main account
benefits.howToUse: Add employee cards in the Chase app/online and set individual spending limits per card. Community datapoints: Chase typically only asks for a name (no SSN required for employee cards), and because business cards don't report to personal bureaus, employee cards don't affect the employee's personal credit.

benefits.name: Purchase protection
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $10,000 per claim, $50,000 per account
benefits.howToUse: New purchases are covered against damage or theft for 120 days from the purchase date (file through the Visa/Chase benefits administrator).

benefits.name: Extended warranty protection
benefits.amountDisplay: Adds 1 year to eligible U.S. manufacturer warranties of 3 years or less (up to $10,000/claim, $50,000/account)
benefits.howToUse: Automatic on items bought with the card — don't buy a retailer extended warranty; if a laptop or tool dies a month after the manufacturer's warranty ends, file a claim with the benefits administrator. Rare on a no-annual-fee card.

benefits.name: Primary auto rental collision coverage
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $60,000 for theft/collision (vehicles with MSRP of $125,000 or less)
benefits.howToUse: Charge the entire rental to the card and decline the rental company's CDW. It's primary — but only when renting for business purposes; Chase requires proof of business travel at claim time, so for personal trips use a Sapphire card's coverage instead. No liability coverage.

benefits.name: Baggage delay insurance
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $100/day for up to 5 days
benefits.howToUse: Reimburses essential purchases (toiletries, clothing) when your bags are delayed 6+ hours by a passenger carrier on a trip charged to the card.

benefits.name: Travel accident insurance
benefits.amountDisplay: Up to $500,000 accidental death or dismemberment
benefits.howToUse: Covers you when you pay for air, bus, train, or cruise transportation with the card.

benefits.name: Travel & emergency assistance and roadside dispatch
benefits.amountDisplay: Referral/dispatch service; cardholder pays for services rendered
benefits.howToUse: Call the Visa benefits line for medical/legal/travel referrals or roadside help (tow, jump start, tire change). The assistance itself is free; you pay the provider's charges.

benefits.name: Chase Offers
benefits.amountDisplay: Targeted extra cash back / statement credits at select merchants
benefits.howToUse: Open the Chase app or online account, scroll to Chase Offers, and click 'Add to card' before the purchase — the bonus posts as cash back after you pay with the card.

benefits.name: Refer-a-friend bonus
benefits.amountDisplay: 20,000 UR points per approved referral, up to 100,000 points per year
benefits.howToUse: Generate your link in the Chase app/online ('Refer friends'). Doctor of Credit notes the referrer bonus only posts if the referred person doesn't already hold a Chase business card — have referrals double-check eligibility before applying.

benefits.name: Foreign transaction fee caveat
benefits.amountDisplay: 3% foreign transaction fee applies (no waiver)
benefits.howToUse: Confirmed: unlike the Ink Business Preferred, the Unlimited charges 3% on purchases outside the U.S. — use a no-FTF card (e.g., your Sapphire Reserve) when traveling abroad.

benefits.name: Business expense management tools
benefits.amountDisplay: Free spending reports and bookkeeping integration
benefits.howToUse: Use the Chase dashboard's quarterly reports and up to 24 months of statements, and sync the account with bookkeeping software to simplify accounting — no separate enrollment.

benefits.name: Automatic credit-limit reviews
benefits.howToUse: Chase automatically considers the account for a credit-limit increase every six months with good behavior; minimum starting line is $3,000.
